headline: Mexico seeks to raise national content of exports to grow up to 3%: Economy
summary: Mexico's economy ministry says the country should use strong machinery and equipment exports to build deeper supply chains and reduce reliance on imported inputs. Officials cite growth of up to 3%.
why: Export content and supply-chain depth affect how much value stays in Mexico's manufacturing sector, which is closely tied to US trade flows.
original_headline: México apuesta por elevar contenido nacional de exportaciones para crecer hasta 3%: Economía
